beats.headline: Bullet time
beats.text: The show has already interviewed Li Jun about his celestial-tier robotic eye. On the way to the brig, Li Jun claps Carl on the shoulder, and the eye unnerves him: a swirling orb of black that, when it works, turns into a miniature clockwork engine inside the round eye. Even the name is a little freaky. The Engine of Tomorrow. It lets him see muscles tensing and slows his own perception of time in short bursts, so he can predict a strike and react with amazing speed, like bullet time in the Matrix films. He and his sister train with it nonstop.

beats.headline: Installing
beats.text: Li Jun is dead. Over the chat Li Na tells Donut not to break the ball apart, and when Donut asks where she is, the answer comes back: she was installing her brother's eye into herself. She has also stopped the mage who was going for Harpocrates, though she is not yet strong enough to stop the god on her own.

beats.headline: A face of blood
beats.text: Someone rushes into the tower behind Carl: Li Na. He had heard her say she was installing Li Jun's fake eye into herself, but the meaning hits him only now. The front of her demonic face is covered in blood. She has gouged out her own eye and replaced it with her brother's celestial-quality one, which lets her slow down time and move with incredible speed. When Carl starts to say he is sorry about her brother, she holds up a hand and stops him.

beats.headline: Who does that?
beats.text: Zhang wipes his eyes, and then the words tumble out of him. She ripped Jun's eye out of his face after he died, and then she ripped her own eye out to install it. Who does that? That was when he should have known she was gone. He used to think he could keep her from going too crazy.

beats.headline: Gears spinning
beats.text: Li Na sits in the middle of the common room, hovering a foot off the floor. She glows, and her good eye stays closed. The other, mechanical eye twitches, its clockwork gears spinning. Mordecai, Mistress Tiatha and Rosetta stand beside her, the white cleaner bot hovers nearby, and a large group has formed around them.
